name: What is siding trim and why is it important to keep it in good condition?

mainEntity.name: What is siding trim and why is it important to keep it in good condition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Siding trim refers to the decorative and protective elements around windows, doors, and corners of your home's exterior. It seals gaps, prevents moisture intrusion, and adds to your home's aesthetic appeal. Maintaining trim is crucial to protect the underlying structure from water damage, rot, and pests. Our team frequently sees water damage in Meridian homes where trim was neglected, leading to more extensive repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Siding trim protects your home from moisture and pests while enhancing its appearance. Keeping it in good condition prevents structural damage.
